subject_name: Communication and In-Group Working Skills_Kỹ năng giao tiếp và cộng tác

general_information.Description: This course will cover both working in groups and communication skills. Assessment structure: * On-going Assessment: - Activity: 10% - Quiz: 15% - Group Assignment : 15% - Group Project : 30% * Final Exam: 30% * Completion Criteria: Every on-going assessment component > 0, Final Exam >=4, Final Result >=5
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (www.cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Establish relationships between class members and group organization
Form a group and conduct group work
Define common teamwork skills such as group communication, membership, leadership, planning and conducting meeting, verbal and nonverbal communication, conflict and cohesion,
Identify key elements, advantages, disavantages and the nature of group communication.
Describe stages of group development and types of group norms.
Explain why member join, stay or leave groups through theory of needs.
Determine group roles and how each role helps hinders groups from achieving a common goal.
Describe and apply strategies for reducing communication apprehensions.
Analyse ways to become effective and powerful leaders.
Understand leadership theories and model of leadership effectiveness.
Describe and identify importance of verbal and nonverbal in teamwork and how to use them effectiveness.
Understand how conflicts appear in groups and how to manage them in cohesion.
Develop a professtional meeting and practice dealing the behavior problems of members in the meeting time.
Apply of parliamentary principles and summary the basic procedures when organizing the meeting.
Identify words and develop clear, concise,logical, coherent,and effective paragraphs.
Format business letters using the full block,modified block,and simplified styles.
Format memos and e-mail properly.
Prepare competently a variety of positive and neutral messages using the direct plan.
Prepare effective negative messages for a variety of purposes using the indirect plan
Write messages that are used for the various stages of collection
Write formal and informal reports
Prepare targeted and general résumés in chronological, functional,or combination format.
Prepare for a successful job interview
Review the knowledge learned and practice overview

schedule.Student Materials: Instruction for Project implementation Including: Presentation + Report Task Description: Students work on the group project which is based on the approved proposal in the Group Assignment. Products of the project can be a media program (web, page, video clip, publication ...), an event (a contest, charity...) That project must be conducted in your community and implemented from week 3 to the end of the semester. At least 1.5 week before the end of the semester, students must complete the project and move on to writing the final project report (students are encouraged to complete the project in weeks 7 or 8 to move through the report writing period). In the last week of the semester, students must present their group project report, describe and evaluate the entire implementation process, achieved results and lessons learned. * Students are not allowed to put your own money into a project, if you have money, you must raise funds. A few examples of products the project students have been made: MV: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g1cO7-Xi9vo Charity: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K3krSINmLVk Event: https://www.facebook.com/HolasGoGreen/ Link page of Softskills Projects, there are many projects that has made posted here by students: https://www.facebook.com/FPTUSoftSkills/"
schedule.Student's Tasks: Write a proposal Including: Presentation + a proposal Task Description: Each group consists of 5 to 7 students working together to develop a social project to achieve 1 or both of the following goals: - Helping disadvantaged communities, for example: new student's life; poor/street children/people; LBGT... - Solving some problems in your community, for example: environmental pollution, animal protection ... Draft and finalize your plan into a group project proposal, then present it to the class for lecturers' approval of the project. After presentating and getting approved by the lecturer, each group will carry out their project in the community, from week 3 to the end of the semester following lecture's instructions. * Students are not allowed to put your own money into a project, if you have money, you must raise funds. Link page of Softskills Projects, there are many projects that has made posted here by students: https://www.facebook.com/FPTUSoftSkills/ Presentation: For the 15 to 30-minute presentation, you are required to showcase all of your key points mentioned in your project proposal in front of your classmates and lecturer. Components of project Proposal: Include the following sections in your project proposal: • Title of the group project • Table of contents • Introduction the group project: The introduction provides background information that profiles your group (e.g., location, goals, size, etc.). It describes the purpose of the proposal request. • Project/product/service description • Purpose • Problem or need • Benefits of the proposal • Description of the solution • Evaluation plan • Qualifications of personnel • Time schedule • Budget (if any) • Glossary (if any) • Appendixes (if any) • Reference list (if any)
